page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 64 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, but it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU and PassMark CPU scores falling into the top 25% tier. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 Foundation and AVX-512 Vector Neural Network Instructions (VNNI), which contribute to strong performance in cryptographic operations and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory performance is also strong, as reflected in the PassMark memory score, though large-block uncached memory read and write bandwidths remain in the average range.

This instance is suited for compute-intensive workloads such as multi-threaded data processing, database operations, and small-scale LLM inference. For example, prompt processing and text generation for a 135M parameter model achieve strong benchmark ratings, though performance scales down to average levels for larger 7B models. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff to consider for I/O-heavy applications.
